$description: BIM Building Width Calculator token category — zone depths per use type, anchored to the Key Plans and Tiles spatial taxonomy. Source: internal design documentation (V3, November 2025). Three zones per use type: Habitat (desks; European Lighting Standard 6m minimum), Magazine (storage beyond Habitat), Corridor (bilateral access; mirrored floor plate). Metre values are authoritative; feet equivalents in $description. All values from completed Key Plan samples except where noted TBD.

professional-office.$description: Professional Office use type — Business tenants in leased office suites. Habitat meets European Lighting Standard exactly at 6.0m.

depth.$description: 19'8" — desks/workstations; European Lighting Standard minimum. With desks perpendicular to façade add 0.7m for three desks in series (see bim.zone.circulation-addition.perpendicular-desk).
12'5" — storage, bookshelves, filing. Balances floor plate to avoid long narrow rectangle.

width.$description: 6'6" — bilateral corridor; mirrored at centre of floor plate. Overdesign by 20% recommended for well-being and smaller-tenant circulation.

private-office.$description: Private Office use type — individual licensed offices (PO-1/PO-2/PO-3). No shared corridor; each office opens directly to a shared floor corridor or building egress. Habitat marginally under 6m from Key Plan sample geometry.

depth.$description: 19'8" — desks/workstations. Marginally under the 6.0m European Lighting Standard; flag for review on final Key Plan sign-off.
4'6" — shallow storage zone; private offices carry minimal shared storage relative to professional suites.

width.$description: No shared bilateral corridor in Private Office use type. Each office accesses the building corridor directly.

laboratory.$description: Laboratory use type — scientific, research, and testing leaseholds. Wider Habitat and Magazine reflect bench depth and fume hood clearances. Corridor corridor matches IBC egress minimums for lab occupancy.

depth.$description: 22'3" — bench depth + circulation + safety clearances per German workplace-circulation standards (ArbStättV). Exceeds European Lighting Standard 6m minimum.
15'9" — chemical storage, equipment staging, fume hood egress zone.

width.$description: 10'0" — wider corridor required for lab cart and equipment transport; IBC egress minimum for high-hazard occupancy.

academic.$description: Academic use type — classrooms, seminar rooms, lecture halls. Habitat shorter than 6m because desks face forward (not toward façade); Corridor absent as academic suites typically open to a shared corridor.

depth.$description: 15'5" — seating rows facing forward; European Lighting Standard applies to workstations, not auditorium-style seating. Review against WELL certification requirements if workstations are present.
9'10" — storage, AV equipment, accessible routes. Note: source spreadsheet shows '3'7" ' for feet which appears to be a transposition error; 3.0m = 9'10" and is used here.

width.$description: No bilateral corridor in Academic use type. Suites open directly to building corridor.

business.$description: Business use type — general commercial office, co-working-adjacent, larger open-plan leaseholds.

depth.$description: 18'6" — the balanced-width option's Habitat depth for Business — Small.
21'9" — the balanced-width option's Magazine depth, narrower than the widest envelope option.

width.$description: 9'0" — Corridor, constant across all width options considered.

business.design_notes: We considered two options for this mixed-option-facade building width: the widest option (5.51/9.26/2.75 → 32.29 m total) versus a balanced option (5.63/6.63/2.75 → 27.27 m total), and confirmed the balanced option. totalWidth formula: 2 × (habitat + magazine) + corridor = 2 × (5.63 + 6.63) + 2.75 = 27.27 m.

medical.$description: Medical use type — clinical, dental, diagnostic, and allied health leaseholds. Wider Habitat reflects exam-table depth and patient circulation. Acoustic and vibration isolation requirements apply.

depth.$description: 23'10" — widest Habitat across use types; exam table depth + patient + clinician circulation per German workplace-circulation standards (ArbStättV) and WELL health standards.
16'0" — medical supply storage, sterilisation, equipment staging. Source spreadsheet shows '16"' (inches) which is likely a display truncation of 16'0" (feet); 4.87m = 15'11.8" ≈ 16'0" confirmed.

width.$description: 9'5" — bilateral corridor; ADA/CSA-B651 compliant width for stretcher and wheelchair passage.

civic.$description: Civic use type — courtrooms, municipal offices, cultural, and civic assembly spaces. Widest overall floor plate due to large Magazine and Corridor requirements for public assembly egress.

depth.$description: 19'8" — workstations/seating at European Lighting Standard minimum.
23'8" — public records storage, jury deliberation rooms, secure document areas; second-widest Magazine zone after Business.

width.$description: 12'0" — widest corridor across all use types; required for public assembly egress, accessible courtroom approach, and ceremonial circulation.

perpendicular-desk.$description: 2'4" — additional depth required in Habitat when desks are placed perpendicular to the façade, to achieve three desks in series with proper clearance under German workplace-circulation standards (ArbStättV — the Arbeitsstättenverordnung, Germany's Workplace Ordinance). Without this addition, Habitat at exactly 6.0m yields only two perpendicular desks. This is a DELTA, not a standalone clearance value: ArbStättV Anhang §3.1 requires 1.0m movement clearance behind a perpendicular-facing seat, versus the 0.3m baseline clearance already accounted for in the parallel-desk Habitat depth; 1.0m − 0.3m = 0.7m is the additional depth this perpendicular arrangement requires on top of the parallel-desk baseline.

private-office.$description: Private Office key plan sizes from completed samples (Key Plan Professional Office workbook, Summary_Key Plans tab V3).

area.$description: 325 SF — PO-1. Minimum size accommodating 1 desk, 1 chair, 1 three-person round table, 1 filing cabinet, 1 credenza, 1 bookshelf, 1 coat rack with German workplace-circulation-standard compliance (ArbStättV) and Façade Frontage. May be 300–400 SF on final Key Plan to ensure correct width.
465 SF — PO-2. Adds second desk, chair, and credenza to PO-1 layout. Approximately 100 SF larger than PO-1; NOT double the area.
685 SF — PO-3. Three-person private office configuration.

professional-office.$description: Professional Office key plan sizes. Only Small currently has a completed sample (130.06 m² / 1,400 SF); Medium and Large are pending Key Plan completion.

area.$description: 1,400 SF — completed sample. Note: Small + Small combination = 260.12 m² / 2,800 SF, filling the gap between Professional Office Large and Corporate Office 1/8 Floor.
